summary: Focused Firestore review found no new critical/high authorization defect; the exact rules source matches executed 71-case evidence. Publishing is separately blocked by an exposed historical App Check debug credential with unconfirmed revocation.

findings.issue: The owner may reset its own usageCounters/daily count and date within the allowed schema, so the client daily counter is not authoritative abuse protection.
findings.recommendation: Treat it as a convenience limit. Do not rely on client-shipped shared credentials for secured public distribution. No hurried production rules change.

publishingGate: BLOCKED — historical App Check debug credential requires owner-controlled revocation confirmation
